process_name: Invoice Processing (請求書承認・処理)
department: 財務会計・経理部門 (Financial Accounting & AP)

primary_portal.window_title: 財務会計システム - Profile 1 - Microsoft Edge

supporting_documents.purpose: Monthly fixed-rate vendor master contract document (月次定額取引先一覧)

sop_phases.ui_element: 財務会計システム Dashboard / Pending Invoice Table

sop_phases.description: Click target invoice row to open detail modal.
Switch to Word document, verify supplier name, agreed rate, and tax rate.

sop_phases.phase_name: Return to Accounting Portal & Insert Confirmation Comment
sop_phases.ui_element: input[placeholder*='処理内容・確認コメント']
sop_phases.description: Paste standard verification audit note (41-43 characters).
Verify voucher code and ensure calculated tax (10%) matches.
Click Approve button, transitioning voucher status to Approved.

technical_automation_blueprint.recommended_approach: Headless Browser / Playwright or Direct REST API Script
technical_automation_blueprint.feasibility_score: High (100% structured inputs, zero cognitive ambiguity)

target_selectors.comment_field: input[placeholder*='確認コメント'], textarea[placeholder*='確認コメント']
